title: The Lion and the Fox
summary: An aging lion pretended to be sick, inviting beasts into his cave to visit him and devouring them....
full_text:
An aging lion pretended to be sick, inviting beasts into his cave to visit him and devouring them.

The fox stood outside. "Why do you not enter?" asked the lion.

"Because," replied the fox, "I see many footprints leading into your cave, but not a single track leading out!"
moral: All tracks lead inward; observe the fate of those who entered before you.
